title: Spiromorphs
subtitle: Procedural generative artwork built from recursive circular motion
coverAlt: Single red and gold Spiromorph generative artwork
summary: Spiromorphs is a procedural generative artwork that produces emergent spiral morphologies from unique hash-based configurations.
body: Each composition is generated through chained circles that overlay periodic motions, producing patterned behavior, quasi-chaotic motion, rotational drift, and layered color variation.

The system includes six morphology types, sixteen color combinations, six symmetry-fold conditions, three animation speeds, and parameters controlling direction, length, opacity, circle count, and rotation.
